title: Three City College audits found gaps in student service records

beats.text: A state education program counted the support services colleges provided.

visual.sub: The first finding concerned timing and supporting files

beats.text: City College reported summer 2015 services in the fall.

visual.kicker: The first finding concerned timing and supporting files

beats.text: All six orientation files tested lacked the needed support.
In 2017, one of 25 service files lacked support.
The next sample found three unsupported files out of 25.

visual.kicker: A printed percentage conflicts with the sample arithmetic

beats.text: One sentence called that four percent. The actual fraction is twelve percent.
The auditors projected about 8,387 records at risk.
The audit did not establish that those students went without services.

visual.kicker: A printed percentage conflicts with the sample arithmetic

beats.text: The college proposed documenting each student plan and the follow-up work.

visual.kicker: The next audit marked the control implemented

beats.text: In 2019 the next audit marked the recommendation implemented.
